==English==

===Alternative forms===
* {{alter|en|bed sheet}}
* {{alter|en|bed-sheet||dated}}

===Etymology===
From {{inh|en|enm|bedeschette}}, {{m|enm|bedshete}}, {{m|enm|bed shete}}, equivalent to {{com|en|bed|sheet}}.

===Pronunciation===
* {{IPA|en|/ˈbɛdʃiːt/|a=RP}}
* {{audio|en|LL-Q1860 (eng)-Flame, not lame-bedsheet.wav|a=US}}

===Noun===
{{en-noun}}

# {{senseid|en|Q391788}}A [[sheet]], a piece of [[cloth]] cut and finished as [[bedlinen]].

====Hypernyms====
* {{l|en|sheet}}

====Hyponyms====
